entities.summary: Yann Pierre Tiersen is a French musician and composer from Brittany. His musical career is split between studio recordings, music collaborations, and film soundtracks songwriting. His music incorporates a large variety of classical and contemporary instruments, primarily the electric guitar, the piano, synthesisers, and the violin, but he also includes instruments such as the melodica, xylophone, toy piano, harpsichord, piano accordion, and even a typewriter. Yann Tiersen was a composers & musicians from Brest (b. 1970-06-23, Brest). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
